notes.title: Sky Link 2 First Quarter 2025 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome![/h1]

Hello and thank you for following Sky Link's epic journey.  

[h2]A New Direction[/h2]

We've been slowly hinting at this in the last few updates, though today I want to 100% confirm it and answer all the questions I've been getting. We're doing something to take Sky Link in a slightly different direction. I'm excited to show it off too. We're experimenting with large maps and it really makes for a fun game. This map is large enough for your biggest and most epic of battles.  This map is setup with five different cities, each one is huge, and they form a ring around the hidden and buried Center Arena. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/75632e06e1ff136b97e3ffcc10931aa69d780732.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Hidden Vaults[/h2]

While experimenting in this map, you would never believe what I found. Flying around, having a good 'ol time, I found Center Arena hidden in the depths under the actual Big Map! This was so exciting! Familiar ground you can really take advantage of! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/7d594372f32ae48a2647405b3aa817327ad67796.jpg[/img]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
Many issues reported in the latest playtests have been fixed, starting with the ability to leave a map through a small hole in Center Arena. These were quickly remedied, to the dismay of some of our testers!

Other fixes this quarter include the scorecard overlap issue. There had been an issue as you loaded into the match, a timer would display a set of overlapping numbers. This has been worked on and a fix has been put in. The scoreboard's timer will now show properly as the game loads into the match.

Many other fixes have gone in to have a more stable game.  One issue in Deathmatch was declaring the incorrect team the winner.  We've seen this one in playtesting and I'm excited our devs have marked this one resolved. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/fa7061ae61eac952df368659529256a16cccbbdc.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Teammates[/h2]

There's a lot going on behind the scenes, too much to mention it all. We've brought on a few new people. There's going to be a lot more in the next update as well, as we're going to pace ourselves and do quarterly updates through out 2025. So stay tuned as you won't believe what happens next! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/f3b5df6b8ccde1732cc522d3522c3a7bff91b5ef.png[/img]


[h2]PLAYTESTS[/h2]

During our Saturday event we do beta testing; checking balance in game while learning to master the finer mechanics of flight. Sky Link: Freefire is difficult to master, though truly easy to pick up and just play.

Last Saturday's playtest was shared on Youtube live, and can be viewed here: https://youtube.com/live/E5s-D1To5X4

We get together every Saturday at 6 PM PST. It’d be awesome if you could stop by and check out Sky Link with us!

[h3]To Join The Beta Test, Join The Discord!   

http://discord.gg/playskylink[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/410d69ce15e2253ae0eaac79600ea334a0fe76d0.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes February 2025
notes.notes:
Hello and thanks for stopping in! Sky Link is a flight simulator first, and a combat experience second. It's an exciting game that's no bodies, and no blood. Lots of explosions though! February has been a blizzard of activity here at Odisi. We've got a couple of new developers on the team and we're ready to take this game to a whole new level. 


[h3][NEW MAPS][/h3]
As promised, there are big ideas in maps coming this year. This week in our internal test we played in a really large map, and it was awesome. There is a ton of potential and this one is going to be big.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/75632e06e1ff136b97e3ffcc10931aa69d780732.jpg[/img]

[h3][MISSILES][/h3]
Missiles have been really a focus this month. Setting up new pathing and allowing for a quick dodge that isn't super easy to do was the goal, and it's looking really good so far. In playtesting I'm able to dodge a good share of missiles when I have time to respond. Really great to have an option besides tactical abilities in missile avoidance. Now when you skill up you'll be unstoppable! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/160944d78b89bfb9b7abf5edc3e4316c6187995e.jpg[/img]

[h3][FLAIRS][/h3]
Flairs are missile avoidance tactical ability number 1. When you hear a missile coming you can fire a flair to redirect the missile from yourself to the flair. This month a heatmap has been added to missiles and drones and the flairs are really something to see in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/1878d03dc502e77ea358755ddb63609309987c66.jpg[/img]

[FIXES]
The one visible fix that everyone will notice in February is the scorecard overlap issue. There's been an issue as you load into the match, the timer would display a set of overlapping numbers. This has been worked on and a fix has been put in. The scoreboard's timer will now show properly as the game loads into the match. 

Many other fixes have gone in to have a more stable game, like an issue in Deathmatch that caused issues figuring out the winning team. We've seen this one in playtesting and I'm excited to say it won't happen again. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/8601de4e0a6b1f76803ad434bebdd8f6b0bb0bdb.jpg[/img]

[h2]PLAYTESTS[/h2]

During our Friday event we do beta testing; checking balance in game while learning to master the finer mechanics of flight. Sky Link: Freefire is difficult to master, though truly easy to pick up and just play.

Last Friday’s playtest was shared on Youtube live, and can be viewed here: https://youtube.com/live/E8M_PWnH4pw
We get together every Friday at 1 PM PST and Saturdays at 4:30 PM PST. It’d be awesome if you could stop by and check it out with us!

notes.title: January 2025 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome! I'm excited to go over all the changes and updates we've been working on this month. January is always a good time to set goals and make plans, and Odisi games has been doing exactly that. In this update we'll go over all the new modes, features, and abilities that we've been working on. So strap in, secure your helmet, and power up your engines.



[h3][NEW MAPS][/h3]
New maps are coming in 2025, though the new maps are still in testing now. There's a lot of room to navigate, a few spots for epic firefights, and a couple spots that are great for those who like to hide and snipe. I'm really excited to see this map flushed out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/c2a1763da8f5df486c78e81f3c6e3304ae72a5fd.jpg[/img]

[h3][MISSILES][/h3]
The missiles have been in the game a long time, and a lot of the drones have access to them. The missiles currently are quick, and if you're targeted you can only escape through use of an ability; like invisibility. The team has been working to make missiles just as quick on the horizontal, and just a little slower to climb giving players a way to escape a missile by ascending. This is going to change the game, and make all drones more versatile. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/e64f174f15e8d0865b9e14e5a4ae3091ffa28a65.jpg[/img]

[h3][FLAIRS][/h3]
The flairs look beautiful, and do a great job at deflecting missiles. Currently we're working through a couple of issues getting the flairs implemented. I'm excited to see flairs as part of the modular line up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/1878d03dc502e77ea358755ddb63609309987c66.jpg[/img]

[h3][CHAOS][/h3]
We've been doing further testing on destructibility of items, and we have signs that can be shot down as well as barrels that explode and windows that can be destroyed. To complete this project we'll be considering every existing map and seeing how best to implement these cool destructables we've created. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/ca4e0342b1196c67d379ca10d9b21c7b6e508831.jpg[/img]

[h3][MODULAR WEAPONS][/h3]
Having the ability to create your own load out will definitely create an instant immersion and replayability will go up too. Currently each drone has a specified weapon, though we've been testing putting each weapon on each drone. Having the largest weapon on the smallest drone does make a difference, though a lot of balance testing will be required to get this one just right. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/ae2072660fd002f459a2738e13ccb44a71fa9155.jpg[/img]

[h3][ROADMAP][/h3]
There's always more to come with Sky Link, so keep your eyes peeled as we're working on a lot of new things! Here's a small summary of what to expect in 2025:

Pinging on the maps is a feature that has been requested and is being worked on! Watch for this one to come out!
We have a new drone that is being worked on, it's sleek, fast, and looks incredible. 
Radar changes are planned in order to better accomodate the 360 degree environment.
Changing weapons will be an option in the future of Sky Link. I'm personally watching for this one!
Destructible elements make any game way more fun. I can't wait to find a way to use these to my advantage!
Future progression changes will include drone attachments and modules you unlock with XP, contracts, and missions. 
As missiles have become more popular, we've been working on flairs on the back end. I can't wait to see all the madness when this is released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/97cfcda433d9c1a6916b57fdc2da05b8997379f9.jpg[/img]

[h2]PLAYTESTS[/h2]

During our Friday event we do beta testing; checking balance in game while learning to master the finer mechanics of flight. Sky Link: Freefire is difficult to master, though truly easy to pick up and just play.

Last Friday’s playtest was shared on Youtube live, and can be viewed here: https://youtube.com/live/E8M_PWnH4pw
We get together every Friday at 1 PM PST and Saturdays at 4:30 PM PST. It’d be awesome if you could stop by and check it out with us!

notes.title: December 2024 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/20ea63071a89779ec54eed06e5e65c88e459e94e.jpg[/img]
Happy New Year!! With the holidays behind us I'm excited to show off some of the hard work from 2024.  So welcome in! Grab a bite and check it out!


2024 was an incredible year. Full of surprises, fun, and new people. Thank you all who have joined in, and a huge welcome to anyone who wants to join our beta tests in 2025!  Without any further delay, here's an Odisi 2024 Sky Link Recap.



[h3][NO MORE RESPAWN][/h3]
The most noticeable change from our public playtesting has been the removal of blackboxes. 
Team deathmatch has had the black boxes and respawning completely removed, so now when your'e out, you're out! The games are so fast now there's an extra 2 rounds that have been added to make it up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/c7f58c9cfe73bf6508f154b96ace9c436d405e6c.jpg[/img]

[h3][PHYSICS BASED FLIGHT][/h3]
Possibly the best change so far has been the focus and attention to detail in the flight of the drones themselves. With the update to Unreal Engine 5 Odisi's taken the time to really do well with the flight within Sky Link. Each drone has a unique flight pattern and propellers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/5cf2feb549b28ba2d1b55628bd2b6111eef1b775.jpg[/img]

[h3][SOCIAL][/h3]
Chat has been implemented within Sky Link, and it's awesome to be able to communicate within the game. Having that line of communication can make the difference between an impressive victor and a total defeat. You can now group with your friends and play matches more specifically to your liking. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/6c0f803984a8603181eb6bfa72eb9a7d5bec6f02.png[/img]

[h3][CHAOS][/h3]
Chaos testing is our implementation of destructible elements in Sky Link, like barrels you can shoot that explode or windows that take damage. Chaos testing began in August and has not yet been added to the public beta testing, though it looks really good now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/aa02adc1c20702580f89f952a3eaf12caa6e845b.jpg[/img]

[h3][MODULAR WEAPONS][/h3]
Having an individual load out makes a huge difference in immersion, and I'm so excited to see this one! Right now in Sky Link each drone has a specific weapon. We've set it up so that you can put any weapon on any drone and that's being testing internally. My favorite has been to take the Megadon's huge weapon and put it on a small drone like the Cyclops. Not only weapons, but specials are modular so this is going to be a huge game changer for immersion. Pictured below is the Cyclops with the Raptor's dual machine guns. Quite a combo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/b38e03a551105164d0d75a6fb15163e7a0d1f42f.jpg[/img]

[h3][AI SYSTEMS][/h3]
In June we overhauled out AI system and the difficulty was so improved we've had to nerf it more recently. Skirmish mode allows you to fight against the AI bots in a free for all system. The bots now use specials and abilities, and at  the proper times! The intensity in Skirmish has never been higher than it was in 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/ae2072660fd002f459a2738e13ccb44a71fa9155.jpg[/img]

[h3][ROADMAP][/h3]
There's always more to come with Sky Link, so keep your eyes peeled as we're working on a lot of new things! Here's a small summary of what to expect in 2025:

Pinging on the maps is a feature that has been requested and is being worked on! Watch for this one to come out!
We have a new drone that is being worked on, it's sleek, fast, and looks incredible. 
Radar changes are planned in order to better accomodate the 360 degree environment.
Changing weapons will be an option in the future of Sky Link. I'm personally watching for this one!
Destructible elements make any game way more fun. I can't wait to find a way to use these to my advantage!
Future progression changes will include drone attachments and modules you unlock with XP, contracts, and missions. 
As missiles have become more popular, we've been working on flairs on the back end. I can't wait to see all the madness when this is released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/1878d03dc502e77ea358755ddb63609309987c66.jpg[/img]


HUGE shout out to our fans, thank you so much for sticking with us through the years. 

Watch for big news in 2025!!

notes.title: November Patch Notes 2024
notes.notes:
Christmas is around the corner and it's always such a beautiful time of the year. All of us here at Odisi Games wish you a Happy Holiday season! Thanks for stopping in! We've had a lot going on and I'm excited to share it, so let's get to it.



Throughout November we have been testing a new game mode internally, sorry beta testers! This mode is a capture the flag and it's been pretty exciting to be a part of. The core functionality of the game's been upgraded, and our client/server model is far more robust now than it's ever been. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/03d9f711adbf2451e16f8a0dffc05da1fcb33a2d.jpg[/img]

Our Chaos testing has been really looking great too. I smile every time I see the new explosions. Chaos is our code name for destructible elements within Sky Link. Soon we'll have barrels that explode, windows that shatter, and signs that you can shoot apart too. Even buildings, potentially. Some internally testing is still on going, though I've been very excited to see this get into the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/aa02adc1c20702580f89f952a3eaf12caa6e845b.jpg[/img]

Within Sky Link the social options have been worked on. There's a nice dark background on the chat so that you can see everything more easily. The leaderboard again is being worked on, and while it's not released yet I'm excited to see this one get fixed. 



In Fixes this month, we've seen quite a few. The top fixes that have been released for November are a fix for matchmaking that would cause a crash. We all saw this one last month! Another top fix this month was related to not being able to leave a match at the end. This was temporarily fixed, though this month it's resolved! We also found and resolved an issue where the enemy health bar would show full after damage had occurred. So watch those bullets now Sky Captains!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/e70200a948b1f160ed5918a0d68e29138e7c6e01.jpg[/img]

We've also seen a new set of map building assets this month, so I'm excited to see what comes next! Keep your loved ones safe and thank you for stopping in! Have a happy holiday!!

notes.title: Happy Thanksgiving!
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome to November![/h2]

Halloween was incredible! Now we get to give our thanks, and I'd like to give a huge shout out to all of the playtesters that have been in and joined us in this incredible experience. Thank you all for your feedback, your time, and all the fun we've had!

[h2]Happy Thanksgiving![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/aa6a28326a70bb404fd38a5ad74387294cd1f7f7.png[/img]

Throughout November Odisi has been working on our roadmap for Chaos, which includes destructable world elements and a new game mode that we've been testing internally. It's also been a ton of fun! In this new mode you have to hold an item for a timer and then bring it in for a touch down. I'm excited for this to get added in, so keep your eyes peeled for this one! We've been playing in Skirmish and the UI needs an update to include this before we'll see it in the testing environment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/fa7061ae61eac952df368659529256a16cccbbdc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/ca4e0342b1196c67d379ca10d9b21c7b6e508831.jpg[/img]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

In the party system, the issue with the messages being sent half written has been fixed! You can now start a message, play a bit, and complete the message at your leisure!

Invisibility for the radar system has had a change put in, and now the enemies' radar will not see you while you're invisible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/b9cd10ee98a931ec0d953ffd7c70980a0ce42910.png[/img]

When your drone crashed into a wall there was an issue causing respawn to occur in a default location. This has been fixed, so you now appear within a range of where you were last seen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/7d594372f32ae48a2647405b3aa817327ad67796.jpg[/img]

A crash that has occurred when a player suddenly disconnected has been patched, no more huge issues for a single disconnect. 

One more huge shout out to the devs here at Odisi. Great work through October, tons of fixes and I'm so excited to see what's to come!



[h2]ROADMAP[/h2]

Chaos testing is expected to continue through November, and we should see modular weapons soon too. The back end has been setup and we've been testing having different weapons and abilities on different drones and it's working fantastic. Once it's setup and built into the UI we'll have every playtester try this out as well. Customized loadouts and destructible elements are coming soon, so stay tuned!

Our incredible maps have been worked on for the new top secret mode we discussed, and a game mode has been set up for it. Testing has gone great, and it's a fun alternative to the standard mode. The UI is not setup for this yet, though it's an exciting addition to our roadmap.

notes.title: August 2024 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome to September![/h1]

August was busy and there's so much progress to discuss in this update! Let's start with the biggest update. Sky Link: Freefire has recently been renamed Sky Link 2! Sky Link 2 will still always be free to play!  With that big announcement, I'm excited to go over all the changes within the game. Thanks for stopping in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/9d9d6cac456cc5b3b0cd82c577e4f2eb6585ec72.jpg[/img]


[h2]New Game Mode![/h2]

We have been testing a no respawn and no blackbox setup for Team Death Match, and it has made matches so fast and furious! The battle has been increased from best of 3 to best of 5 to compensate for the quickness of the rounds, and this also makes it much more difficult for an ally to steal your kill. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/7d594372f32ae48a2647405b3aa817327ad67796.jpg[/img]


[h2]Chaos and Destruction![/h2]

Throughout August Odisi's focus has been spread between a few things. We have been working on Chaos testing, to add elements into Sky Link that are destructible. Being able to shoot out a window or knock down a building. We have done some light testing as a team on the destruction of a small building, and it definitely will increase immersion when you and your squad are firing on all cylinders in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/20ea63071a89779ec54eed06e5e65c88e459e94e.jpg[/img]


[h2]Enemy Drones[/h2]

The enemy drones powered by AI have been super powered this month. Now when you play a skirmish the bots can play every drone type, and they use their abilities to the maximum too! To play in Skirmish is much more challenging, and we've taken the bots and allowed them to be added to the player versus player Team Death Match mode, making for huge and intense battles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/9e9297972a914682e8e6d82098266edbef86496f.jpg[/img]


[h2]Modular Weapons[/h2]

Modular weapons have been added on the back end as well, so as developers we can test the various weapons on each drone to confirm issues and errors. Being able to put the big weapons on a small light drone is nothing short of amazing. Of course you have far less armor on a smaller drone, which just makes it all the more exciting. 

The original Cyclops:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/337419a452fd9a59d53f05d5fa9fba271deeebee.jpg[/img]

This Cyclops has the Raptor's Machine Guns for a quick attack load out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/b38e03a551105164d0d75a6fb15163e7a0d1f42f.jpg[/img]


[h2]VFX[/h2]
The bullet impact has also been a focus, along with the Chaos and destructibility being added in the near future. To keep up to date with all the changes visit our Trello, listed below. To be even more involved, join us in our weekly beta testing! We love to get new people in and need all the feedback we can get. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/084acff7dac604894aeaadd226463e2fa0d406d5.jpg[/img]


[h2]SFX[/h2]

The ability for sound to create immersion can never be understated, and there's been a lot of audio updates and changes throughout August too. The garage itself has had the sounds reimagined. notes.title: July 2024 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy July![/h1]


Welcome Sky Captains! 

It's officially summer time! Time to break out the lawn chairs and and some potato chips. Fire up that barbecue! Sky Link 2 has been moving in a new direction, and we've put a lot of work behind it already. I'm pretty excited to go over all of the changes, so let's get to it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/eda88c72dd11b06a4b71b4787dfad1641ae41944.png[/img]
(The world of Sky Link)


[hr][/hr]

[h2]Quality of Life Updates [/h2]

First and foremost, we have a quality of life update that everyone has been asking for in all our playtests. Now when you leave Sky Link, your settings will save and be available for you on your return!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/2884dead580114d382bb07185ab600215c262cef.jpg[/img]
(Controller settings were added earlier this year!)


[hr][/hr]

[h2] Some Quick Planned Updates  [/h2]


And if that isn't enough, we have a whole world of changes to go over this month too. Modular weapons are coming! Today each drone is set with a specific weapon, and our developers are working to open this up so every load out can be as unique as the pilot themselves. In our last play test I was able to test this out and it's already working great on the back end. Keep your eyes peeled for updates on this, as it'll be a big one. 

Along with modular weapons on the drones, we've been implementing new abilities as well. With the missiles deadly homing ability we have created flairs you can equip that will attract the missiles. I hope to see the flare reach the game for everyone's use this next month. The flair's sound effect is also awesome!

Also planned for the future, our devs are working on something we're calling chaos destructibility. Keep your eyes peeled for more about this in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/bd3c88a6c917bd2468f37d0daf2850ccd6bd9988.jpg[/img]
(Cyclops' Stasis Field can create chaos in battle!)


[hr][/hr]

[h2]Map Updates[/h2]

Lots of changes to our maps in June to go over. Sandstorm has had a few holes patched, and the spawn points have been adjusted to prevent spawn camping. The Sandstorm map is also larger now, to better accomodate our physics based flight. In Sandstorm, and in Split; the trees now have collision as well, so watch your flight path! Audio setup on Sandstorm, Fjords, and Center arena have been improved, with better ambient noise and reverb. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/60c49f944ad6cd4daf7209c1f9d35040f80ac5cd.jpg[/img]
(The Sandstorm map is shown above)


[hr][/hr]

[h2]Party System[/h2]

Our party system is strong as it's ever been with our latest round of updates. The invitation system now allows you to select all your friends and invite them at once, and it's working like a dream! There's never been a better time to get your friends into Sky Link!

Tons of changes and fixes go in every month.  One issue we have noticed in our play tests was a crash that would randomly occur when a new player  entered the match as the match was ending. This has been fixed on the back end, along with issues on the play button's visibility.  The Discord Button in the game has also undergone an operation in June that has brought it back to full operation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/585a4092894de39244219214c4383345986eee19.jpg[/img]
(Party System in Game shown)


[hr][/hr]

[h2]Game AI[/h2]

A lot of work has been put into the Artificial Intelligence in the game. During gameplay bots can now be added to a Team Death Match, and they will follow a designated leader on each team. We've had some 16 player battles in this orientation, and it's smooth and fast. The bots themselves now use all weapons and abilities, and have much more intelligence in their actions. They are now a little bit scary to be honest. Bots damage statistics also required some correction in June. 

Missile logic has also had a huge make over in June. If a missile has target lock and the target gets obstructed by an obstacle, the missile will now extrapolate the target's next position based on last tracked position and velocity. Missile guidance has also been moved server side to make missiles more reliable. Missiles will now also lock onto the closest target when more than one is in range. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/dbb234938b032e8f1c1490cddaa3cd5ab2b3b7ec.jpg[/img]
(Bots are far more deadly now!)


[hr][/hr]

[h2][VFX][/h2]

And last but not least, our visual effects expert has been crunching all month. There's so many changes in VFX to go over! All visual effects have had a new scale parameter added on the back end, to help dynamically match explosion to damage. The barriers had a lot of attention. The shields would inhibit some of the view while in first person and this feedback has led to a new iteration of shield that isn't going to block your view when you play. 

Tons of work and a lot of passion and excitement from the team this month as we round through July. Lots of excitement to come as well, I look forward to seeing you again next month! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/410d69ce15e2253ae0eaac79600ea334a0fe76d0.png[/img]

notes.title: June Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Welcome Sky Captains to the start of an incredible summer! 

Odisi Games has been working diligently to get Sky Link ready for release, and there are some incredible improvements this month to share; so let's get to it!

To start out, our smallest map has been shown a lot of love this month. Center Arena is a cave system that is enclosed, and it was just a bit too small with the updated flight mode we implemented earlier this year. Originally it was made for a skirmish mode and then later became part of our Team Death Match rotation. We decide to expand the map, introducing 2 bases on the sides and creating more spaces for flanking. Now you can be much more strategic with your allies whenever you encounter this map! Another small change I feel really good about, the discord button in the game now works to connect you to the Sky Link discord! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/7d594372f32ae48a2647405b3aa817327ad67796.jpg[/img]


[hr][/hr]

[h2][SKIRMISH][/h2]

We have been working with the enemy AI systems and have been experimenting with all the drones in skirmish. This has made skirmish a much more dangerous place, and much more like playing against real players in a death match. The Skirmish mode puts you into a map with a number of enemies and you can now watch how they react with each drones' special abilities. Really changed the mode this month! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/8601de4e0a6b1f76803ad434bebdd8f6b0bb0bdb.jpg[/img]


[hr][/hr]

[h2][TEAM DEATH MATCH][/h2]

We are rethinking a few systems for a more personalized experience in Team  Death Match. The maps are being synchronized to size more appropriately for the battles we want to see. Spawn points are being moved to prevent spawn camping. Health pack positions are moved this month in Fjords as well. Also fixed this month is the issue where players were sometimes initialized as spectators at the beginning of a match.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/a4aa0d121e5bdc1a67d09713fe0b285cef11c97c.jpg[/img]


[hr][/hr]

[h2][SOCIAL][/h2]

The party system is looking better than ever, and several of the issues with its' original implementation have been corrected too. You can no longer accept invites while already queued up for a match. The invite button is now disabled when you have no one online to invite. The issue with names showing up in parties has been corrected as well in June. In testing the party system has been reliable and it's really great to be able to join your friends for a match. The ready button has been corrected for the party leader, where it used to require two clicks you can now ready in just one. Some changes are still pending as well;  the ability to add friends from players in your matches is still on the road map so keep your eyes peeled!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/6c0f803984a8603181eb6bfa72eb9a7d5bec6f02.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]

[h2] [VFX] [/h2]

In Visual Effects, our legacy system is being completely reworked using the newer Niagara system available in Unreal 5. And the effects have been stunning! We're seeing better explosions with less frames dropped, and able to really do a lot more with the new system. 

A few of the drones have a barrier, and the effects for these barriers have been recreated this month. There's a small disc that's shot out and this disc creates the barrier. Definitely looks cool and it works a lot better with the first person view as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/13d467e020f15de4b44be80ffb1048e48f098158.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]

[h2][SFX] [/h2]

Sound really causes immersion, and Odisi has been working through the new Unreal 5's experimental HDR system. So far, it's incredible. The sniper shots ring out across the map, the gattling gun has a roll to the constant release of shells. There's a feeling in the air when you can hear the EMP from the cyclops as the lightning arcs across your ship. 

Updates in June for Sound Effects include new Invisibility sounds, and a Stealth ability sound so you have instant confirmation when your skill goes into effect. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/b9cd10ee98a931ec0d953ffd7c70980a0ce42910.png[/img]


[hr][/hr]

[h2][PLAYTESTS][/h2]

notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome Sky Captains![/h1]

We have had a hard worked month, and there is a lot to show off with our migration to Unreal Engine 5.3 further behind us now. Key bindings have been a large focus through April, and we have the ability now to use controllers! 

[h2]Key Mappings[/h2]

This is the one I’m most excited about myself. We saw this begin last month, and this month we’ve seen the results in our beta test environment for our Friday beta tests. Former issues with remapping the mouse buttons have been resolved in a series of updates this month, and a new set of bindings has been made available for all commands in game(allowing easy access to controllers and partial support for joysticks). Come test with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/2884dead580114d382bb07185ab600215c262cef.jpg[/img]

[h2]Weapons Update[/h2]

Missiles have had several fixes and changes this month. 
A target detection now takes into account the path of the missile and explosion effects. 
The intercept direction of the missile is calculated by taking into account the missile's acceleration, and its relative velocity between the missile and the target. This makes missiles that work more as you’d expect missiles to operate. 

The projectiles from the shotgun, rifle, and machine gun now go through friendly shields. 

Another fix for April is that missiles now explode on enemy shields, so keep those shields up Sky Captains!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/160944d78b89bfb9b7abf5edc3e4316c6187995e.jpg[/img]


[h2]Visual Effects[/h2]

Muzzleflash effects for the shotgun, rifle, and machinegun have been cleaned up and optimized, as have smoke effects you’ll see in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/46254743cbe9c1c6a49eae5a95bf76d2af4c49a1.png[/img]

Surface types have been added, and surface effects have been implemented in a system that will now differentiate surface types for more variation as you shoot into walls and other surfaces. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/2c2462a9ae074db3a1888a7b7d1858e695e13090.png[/img]

[h2]Party and Chat System[/h2]

Notifications have been added for chat messages. 

The Party system has been created to allow you to easily join your friends. A chat system has been recreated as well for in game communication. There were some challenges with getting this chat system to operate properly in all menus and across Sky Link: Freefire globally, though with our latest update in April the chat system is much more robust and stable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/0bb327b82b8bafd7ec53d43209b58cffcb7d8a70.jpg[/img]

Long messages are autowrapped to the following line
The last channel you’ve used remains the default when chat is opened
An icon has been added to let you know when you have an unread  message / notification
Added a notification in the case of an error when inviting someone to your party
Number added to unread messages so you can see how many are waiting
Limitation added to prevent sending messages to all during PreMatch
Fixed an issues closing the chat box

Mouse cursor issues with the chat interface have been resolved

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/6c0f803984a8603181eb6bfa72eb9a7d5bec6f02.png[/img]

The Deathmatch Tally screens’ issues with presenting all drone’s thumbnails have been resolved. The thumbnail images would fail to load if anyone had joined late or left the match prematurely. When you see the final screen, you can now recognize each player’s drone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/326431bb872fd008704a1317ed99668b71f8a415.jpg[/img]

notes.title: December Patch Notes And Year End Recap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/cd604b7072bde4f21833584c3acf4862d3ae289a.png[/img]

Thank you for stopping in! Odisi Games wants to wish you a Happy New Year! It's really been an incredible year here at Odisi Games. We are moving the game in a slightly new direction, and it's so exciting to be on the forefront of this adventure! 

So, what's new in Skylink:Freefire?

We started the year with an overhaul to the flight system, and we’re now on a physics based flight that feels more responsive, quicker, and far more realistic. This was quite the undertaking. The physics based flight system was initially finished around March and then each drone had to be updated to work with the new system. In the middle of setting up all of the drones to work in the new flight system, it was decided that Skylink would move into more modular weapons. Making things modular will ensure more variety in every battle and my favorite part, it’s going to make your drone far more personal once you customize it.  


[h1]December Patch Notes[/h1]

More recently we have been working on making a sharper and more high tech user interface. New icons for health pickups came out this week, and they are looking so good! Included with that, we recently setup a leaderboard. The leaderboard really ties the game together, giving valuable feedback to the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/6df528cb5e5d9419f25007ecbb3f0b57f8d7c1da.jpg[/img]


Some other updates seasoned players will notice; Team mates come back with less health now by design, so it's not as much of a swing when you manage to bring back your ally.  The recovery system has had a lot of changes this year too. Grappling as an attack has been removed. When you grapple a drone today the drone is a stable force on the map and you will move to it. Last year it was the opposite. 

The Pandora Map has been reworked into an entirely new map. Named Bridgehead, it has a central island that provides lots of cover; and if you look closely you can now see a derelict mining operation was once in full swing here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/5b5e9d2588a64206b259480f67c56360d8da8ab8.jpg[/img]

Sound effects for weapons have had a lot of attention and it's really improved the look and feel of Skylink this year. 

The Garage has had a lot of attention this year, becoming much bigger and there’s even a playskylink.com QR code hidden in the garage for you to find. The ambient music in the garage has had some changes as well, with some smoothing and a lowering of the overall volume. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40970942/3fc1dffdf70b672e504ed5831f349d7cfc638f34.jpg[/img]

There are certainly current challenges and some distance to go…   though you're welcome to join us on Friday as we do our beta tests to continue to push the envelope and determine just what the technology can let us achieve. If that sounds exciting; join us Friday at 1 PM Pacific in the Skylink discord at Discord.GG/playSkyLink.

Throughout the month of October we here at Odisi games have really been focused on getting the new physics based flight setup and adjusted, so that it's easy to pickup and yet more difficult to master. We’re making our way towards the end goal of having all drones, weapon systems, and armors be interchangeable and more modular, and I’m excited to see this through.
